subject: Request: short demo window extension & sandbox credit for HelioHealth POC
messages:
From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@heliohealth.com>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@heliohealth.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: HelioHealth POC - short extension & sandbox credits?

Hi Rafael / Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo earlier. We're happy with model quality but hit a snag when wiring the FHIR connector into our staging environment. The connector intermittently drops on long patient lists and engineering needs a couple of full end-to-end runs to repro and patch.

Our current demo window (ends 2027-04-21) is tight — can Redwood extend the demo by two weeks and top up our sandbox with an extra 50k tokens (or equivalent credit) so we can complete the integration and run end-to-end QA? Without the extension our execs won't see the full end-to-end flow and the procurement conversation stalls.

Quick details:
- Root symptom: connector TLS renegotiation on >1k record payloads (we've attached a short error snippet)
- Engineering ETA to stable: ~10 business days once we can reproduce consistently
- What we need: two-week demo extension + 50k tokens sandbox credit

Appreciate your help — happy to jump on a 15-min call if that helps speed this.

Best,
Alex Reed
Product Manager, HelioHealth
alex.reed@heliohealth.com

Attachment: connector-error-snippet.txt (log excerpt)

Alex — thanks for the clear write-up and the log. I'm escalating this internally to get you an answer quickly. I've looped in Karthik (SE) for a technical read and Monica (CS) for the credits/extension ops. Neha for heads-up on commercial impact.

Karthik / Monica — HelioHealth (DEAL-7831) is requesting a 2-week demo extension and ~50k tokens sandbox top-up due to integration flakiness. They estimate ~10 business days to reproduce/patch once they can run longer test jobs. This is a typical engineering delay; recommend we grant extension + credits to keep momentum. Can you confirm the operational steps and quick approval path?

Alex — I will confirm as soon as Monica/Neha give the go-ahead. If helpful I can set up a 15-min triage tomorrow.

Thanks,

Folks — quick technical read: the attached root-cause notes show a reproducible TLS renegotiation when payloads exceed ~800 records; it's timing-sensitive and affects the long-run batch jobs they need. Helio's ask (2 weeks + 50k tokens) is reasonable given the work described — it buys them multiple full runs and a verification window.

Operationally I recommend:
- Extend demo window by 14 days (new end date 2027-05-05)
- Apply sandbox credit equivalent to 50k tokens (apply as one-time credit against the sandbox account)
- Add a temporary higher concurrency limit (2->4) for their staging project for the next 14 days to let them test faster

If we approve, I can draft the credit adjustment CSV and run the sandbox config change with infra. I've attached integration-root-cause-notes.pdf with details.

Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

We approve the following for HelioHealth (DEAL-7831):

I've submitted the credit adjustment and attached the confirmation CSV: credit-adjustment-confirmation.csv. You should see the changes within the hour. If you'd like us to monitor the first long-run job, we can schedule a 30-min support session this week (Karthik and I will be on the call).
